items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Kenny Man, that name doesn’t ring a bell.

ctx.x: What I have a say Savoy reissued. It is under Howard McGee's name. Actually, no, I got this out of the Savoy records discography. It is from the discography and they have it as 1948, in February. They do not have a date. It indicates that, although it was issued on Savoy, it was originally done on a label called Parrot. The personnel was McGee, Eckstein, Kenny Man, Hank Jones, Ray Brown, and JC Herd.
Kenny Man, that name doesn’t ring a bell. That is the person that ever her the name, to my knowledge. I wonder if that is accurate. Sometimes, these things kind of get distorted.
Yeah. One of the things we want to try and do is identify things that may not be accurate.
